Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

rēs

rēs, reī f.

noun, fifth declension

a thing that happens, an event, an affair; the fact, the facts, what really is (as against words or opinion); the matter, the situation; a thing, an object

In this lexicon

  • event

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 1.13.2: rēs dignae litterīs nostrīs

  • fact

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Tusc. 5.32: rem enim opīnor spectārī oportēre, nōn verba; Traupman 97: rēs ipsa indicat, the facts speak for themselves

  • situation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 3.24.2: tōta rēs quō locō sit; Liv. 2.47.5: quō locō rēs essent (Lewis & Short)

  • thing

    the recommended word · classical · Phaedr. 3.12.3: quanta rēs; Sen. Ep. 84.8: imāgō rēs mortua est
